title: Potassium & the ECG

findings.where: Images 8 and 16; step "worked"; potassiumStepDesc() final sentence
findings.title: Alternative text assigns an illustrative ECG to the client
findings.problem: For abnormal values, the description says the strip is outlined "as this client's." Only a potassium value was supplied—not an ECG. This wording implies patient-specific ECG findings despite the surrounding illustrative caveats.
findings.fix: Say: "The hyperkalemia findings panel is outlined because the potassium is elevated; the strip is illustrative, not this client's recorded ECG." Apply the equivalent wording to hypokalemia.

assessment: One misleading text alternative remains. No clinical blocker identified in the supplied potassium content.
